errors.endAfterStart: The end magnitude must exceed the start magnitude.
errors.presetUnavailable: This preset is no longer available.

path.title: Path
path.scope: One palette per depth, blended between stops
path.note: Magnitude increases while zooming. In circles mode, it also varies with the distance to the view center.
path.hints: Click: select · drag: move · double-click the strip: add a stop here · double-click a stop: edit it in Palettes.
path.editingNote: “{name}” is loaded in the Palettes tab: every change applies to the path. Disabling the path restores the previous palette.
path.extractTitle: Saves the blend at the current magnitude to the library, with its materials and images (200-point approximation; in circles mode, at the cursor only)

stop.title: Selected stop
stop.scope: Palette, position and transition of the stop
stop.endpointLocked: The start and end stops follow the range
stop.captureTitle: Copies the manual palette and its materials into this stop

saved.title: Saved paths
saved.name: Path name
saved.note: Local save on this browser: paths are not synced with the cloud. Each stop keeps a copy of its palette.

textures.title: Textures and compute
textures.note: Images shared between stops, 128 MiB budget. Orbit frequency and trap geometry stay common; materials and effects vary from one stop to the next. ExpMap always bakes the circles.
